issues.description: The problem statement is inconsistent about whether calculateTotalPrice should be static. In the UML excerpt (problem_statement.md lines 25-34) calculateTotalPrice is presented as a regular public method (no static qualifier), while later in the textual specification (problem_statement.md lines 77-80) the instructions explicitly require calculateTotalPrice to be static. This contradiction can confuse students about the intended method signature and whether the method should operate on a shared stock.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the requirement consistent: either update the UML in problem_statement.md to indicate calculateTotalPrice is static (e.g., underline or add a note) or remove the textual claim that it must be static. Explicitly state the intended signature in the specification (e.g., "public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)") so students know which method signature to implement.
